name: prefer-named-exports
description: Prefer named exports in TypeScript/ESM modules; avoid default exports when a named export is sufficient. Avoid re-export renaming (export { X as Y }) unless migration or barrel constraints require it—import the canonical name from the source package instead. Use in Podverse and Metaboost when adding or editing modules, barrel files, worker commands, packages, and app code. Framework-required defaults are the exception.
